Action.Name: Read All Zone Labels from Panel

Field.Label: Reads the label for every configured zone device from the panel and saves each one to its device's 'Label Text' property, OVERWRITING any existing value. Useful for the initial bulk-sync when zones have been reconfigured but the panel's stored labels are stale. Runs in the background — does NOT block this dialog. Briefly enters installer mode for each zone (~15-20s per zone), so a system with 40 zones takes ~10-15 minutes. ENVISALINK IS NOT SUPPORTED — IT-100 only. All partitions must be disarmed for the entire duration. The installer code must be configured in the plugin's main config. Watch the event log for progress.
Retry Passes:
Number of extra passes over failed zones after the initial pass. 0 disables retry entirely. Recommended: 2 (gives 3 total attempts per zone). Range: 0-5.
Inter-Pass Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between passes for the panel to fully recover from installer mode before retrying failed zones. Recommended: 15-30 seconds. Range: 0-120.
Inter-Zone Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between zones within a single pass. Letting the panel settle reduces the rate of stage 1 timeouts. Recommended: 3-10 seconds. Range: 0-30.

Action.Name: Read Only Empty Zone Labels from Panel

Action.Name: Read Specific Zone Labels from Panel

Field.Label: Reads the labels for the specified zones from the panel and saves each one to its device's 'Label Text' property, OVERWRITING any existing value. Useful for picking up a handful of specific zones without re-reading the whole panel. Runs in the background — does NOT block this dialog. Briefly enters installer mode for each zone (~15-20s per zone). ENVISALINK IS NOT SUPPORTED — IT-100 only. All partitions must be disarmed for the entire duration. The installer code must be configured in the plugin's main config.
Zone List:
Comma-separated zone numbers and/or ranges. Examples: "5" or "1,3,5,7" or "1-10" or "1,3,5-10,15". Zones must be 1-64. Any zone that doesn't have a configured Indigo device is silently skipped.
Retry Passes:
Number of extra passes over failed zones after the initial pass. 0 disables retry entirely. Recommended: 2 (gives 3 total attempts per zone). Range: 0-5.
Inter-Pass Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between passes for the panel to fully recover from installer mode before retrying failed zones. Recommended: 15-30 seconds. Range: 0-120.
Inter-Zone Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between zones within a single pass. Letting the panel settle reduces the rate of stage 1 timeouts. Recommended: 3-10 seconds. Range: 0-30.

Enters installer mode and triggers DSC section 998, which broadcasts the labels stored on this keypad to every other PK5500 keypad on the system. Useful after writing labels via this plugin so all keypads in the house show the updated text. Takes ~30-90 seconds depending on how many keypads are on the bus. ENVISALINK IS NOT SUPPORTED — IT-100 only. All partitions must be disarmed for the duration. The installer code must be configured in the plugin's main config. NOTE: if running this immediately after a label write, wait ~30 seconds first — the panel transiently shows 'System is Unavailable' while it recovers from installer programming, and starting the broadcast during that window can fail.

Action.Name: Write All Zone Labels to Panel

Field.Label: Writes the label for EVERY configured zone device to the panel, OVERWRITING whatever the panel currently has. Each zone takes ~60-90 seconds due to per-character LCD verification, so a system with 40 zones takes 40-60 MINUTES. Long-running. ENVISALINK IS NOT SUPPORTED — IT-100 only. All partitions must be disarmed for the entire duration. The installer code must be configured in the plugin's main config. After it finishes you'll usually want to run 'Broadcast Labels to All Keypads' to push the changes to all keypads. Watch the event log for progress.
Retry Passes:
Number of extra passes over failed zones after the initial pass. 0 disables retry entirely. Recommended: 2 (gives 3 total attempts per zone). Range: 0-5.
Inter-Pass Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between passes for the panel to fully recover from installer mode before retrying failed zones. Recommended: 15-30 seconds. Range: 0-120.
Inter-Zone Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between zones within a single pass. Letting the panel settle reduces the rate of stage 1 timeouts. Recommended: 3-10 seconds. Range: 0-30.

Action.Name: Write Changed Zone Labels to Panel

Field.Label: Writes only zones whose 'Label Text' field has been edited since the last successful read or write. Uses a per-device 'lastSyncedLabelText' tracking property updated automatically when a read or write succeeds. Zones that have never been read/written are SKIPPED — do an initial sync via 'Read All Zone Labels' or 'Write All Zone Labels' first. Each zone takes ~60-90 seconds due to per-character LCD verification. ENVISALINK IS NOT SUPPORTED — IT-100 only. All partitions must be disarmed for the entire duration.

Number of extra passes over failed zones after the initial pass. 0 disables retry entirely. Recommended: 2 (gives 3 total attempts per zone). Range: 0-5.

Inter-Zone Delay (seconds):
How long to wait between zones within a single pass. Letting the panel settle reduces the rate of stage 1 timeouts. Recommended: 3-10 seconds. Range: 0-30.

Requests that the currently-running bulk label operation (Read All, Read Empty, Write All, Write Specific, Write Changed) stop cleanly. The worker checks the cancel flag BETWEEN zones, so it can take up to ~90 seconds to honour the request (it lets the currently-in-progress zone finish first). The bulk operation will log that it was cancelled and how many zones it completed before stopping. Has no effect if no bulk operation is running. NOTE: 'Broadcast Labels' CANNOT be cancelled — once section 998 is sent the panel is broadcasting autonomously on the keybus and doesn't accept interruption.
